title: Operator reconcile loop failure when conditional Helm values introduce strict CRD schema mismatch
creator: Nina Patel
description: Summary: A production customer running a Private (VPC) deployment experienced a full controller-manager reconcile stall immediately following a Helm upgrade. Root cause: a conditional template introduced in chart v2.7.0 changes the type/shape of an optional field in the CR manifest (opaqueSecrets.enabled -> object vs boolean). When the operator reconciler attempted to read the updated CR, strict CRD validation + conversion webhook returned a validation error; the operator lacked a safe-path for unknown field shapes and entered repeated reconcile failures, causing nodeagents to be stuck in terminating state and blocking subsequent upgrades. This ticket tracks triage, emergency hotpatch, coordinated rollback/upgrade steps, and the postmortem with permanent fixes (chart validation, operator defensive parsing, and a migration path).
steps_to_reproduce: helm pull redwood-operator --version 2.7.0 && helm template mycluster redwood-operator-2.7.0 --values sample-conditional-values.yaml > rendered.yaml
kubectl get pods -n redwood | grep operator  # observe CrashLoopBackOff on controller-manager
kubectl logs -n redwood deploy/controller-manager --since=1h | grep -i validation
mitigation: Immediate mitigation for impacted customers: (1) Roll back Helm release to 2.6.x using 'helm rollback' and set --force if necessary; (2) Apply a temporary conversion-webhook patch that accepts both shapes (patch provided below); (3) Restart the controller-manager with --enable-graceful-fallback to skip strict schema enforcement while we apply migration. These steps were executed for the two escalated customers and restored reconciliation within 18 minutes.
resolution_plan: Publish hotfix release private-operator-2.7.1-hotfix containing: defensive parsing in reconciler, a migration utility that normalizes old/new field shapes, and a Helm chart guard that validates conditional templates before upgrade.
Backport critical parsing/fallback code to 2.6.x branch for customers who cannot upgrade immediately.
Add a pre-upgrade CI job that renders Helm templates with representative conditional matrices to catch shape changes.
Update upgrade runbook with explicit migration flag (--set operator.migrateFieldShapes=true) and canary rollout instructions.
Postmortem and retro: doc the incident, update release gating, and create an eval to prevent similar regressions.
links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/2245 -- hotfix PR: operator defensive parsing and migration
